node.label: cholesteryl ester storage disease
node.definition: A form of lysosomal acid lipase deficiency characterized by progressive cholesterol esters and triglyceride accumulation in tissues and organs typically presenting with hepatosplenomegaly, liver dysfunction and/or dyslipidemia.
